headline: 28.13% of 109,192 tested apps are unavailable in mainland China
dek: The corpus-scale storefront comparison complements the smaller fixed panel with a much broader catalogue.

claims.statement: The current AppleCensorship corpus reports 28.13% unavailable among 109,192 tested apps for mainland China.

method.summary: See the complete embedded upstream payload and its raw feed

limitations: Storefront unavailability can have policy, licensing, commercial or technical causes; the percentage alone does not identify cause.
